subject: Budget holder nomination + security handoff for NovaEdge pilot
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Patel <ari@novaedgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap of today's call — NovaEdge capacity & next steps

Hi Ari — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Short recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary use case: inference for clinical NLP at ~200–400 concurrent clinical sessions, 1.2–1.8M tokens/day.
- Key constraints: latency target ~150ms p50, data residency in US-only region, SOC2 evidence required for pilot.
- Decision criteria: accuracy on diagnosis extraction, predictable token cost, SLA for uptime.

Proposed next steps
1) Could you nominate the person who owns the budget for this pilot (econ buyer / budget owner)? If you prefer, introduce them on reply and we’ll include a short mutual action plan.
2) Please introduce the procurement and security contacts so we can get SOC2 and data handling info into a single thread.
3) Ben (cc'd) will follow up with a short pilot estimate and MAP (mutual action plan) — see attached one‑pager + estimate.
4) Optional: 30-minute procurement/security sync next week to align on checklist.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (one page), pilot-estimate.xlsx (sample cost envelope)

Thanks again — I’ll wait for the budget owner/procurement contacts and will schedule the MAP session once we have names.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
From: Ari Patel <ari@novaedgehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap of today's call — NovaEdge capacity & next steps

Thanks Kim — good recap.

I'm looping in two people to this thread: Maria Gomez (CFO) to field budget/approval questions and our procurement inbox. They should be the right folks to confirm spend authority and procurement rhythm.

Introductions:
- Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novaedgehealth.com> — CFO, NovaEdge Health
- Procurement <procurement@novaedgehealth.com> — central procurement team

A few notes from me:
- Security is a hard requirement for pilots touching clinical data. If you can provide SOC2 Type II and a short summary of your data handling (where logs live, retention windows, encryption in transit/at rest) that will speed things up.
- We like MAPs — please include an explicit acceptance milestone for our security review and a pilot wrap decision date.

Happy to be involved as needed but Maria & procurement should drive the next leg.

— Ari
Ari Patel
Director of Platform Engineering, NovaEdge Health
ari@novaedgehealth.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novaedgehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@novaedgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Intro & proposed MAP — Redwood pilot for NovaEdge

Hi Maria and procurement team — nice to e-meet you. Thanks Ari for the intro.

Ben (Account Exec) and Grace (Solutions Engineer) are copied — they'll run the pilot scoping and security checklist. Quick summary of what we propose to deliver for a 6‑week pilot:
- Pilot scope: 10k daily inference requests (clinical NLP), US-only data residency, latency target 150ms p50.
- Deliverables: deployment guide, SOC2 attestation package, 1-week onboarding, weekly check-ins, pilot wrap report with metrics.
- Pricing: initial estimate attached; we'll provide a formal SOW after we align on scope.

Proposed next meeting slots (30 minutes) to cover procurement/security + MAP:
- Tue 12/8 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue 12/8 14:00–14:30 PT
- Wed 12/9 09:00–09:30 PT

Attached: MAP-NovaEdge-v1.xlsx (draft mutual action plan), redwood-one-pager.pdf, pilot-estimate.xlsx

Link to shared MAP (editable): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-MAP-NovaEdge

If those slots don't work, tell us a couple alternatives and we will accommodate. Ben will follow up with a short SOW template and SOC2 materials.

Best regards,
Kimberly
From: Procurement <procurement@novaedgehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & proposed MAP — Redwood pilot for NovaEdge

Thanks for the overview. A few immediate asks from procurement/security before we confirm a pilot: 
1) Please provide SOC2 Type II report or a SOC2 letter with scope; redaction ok.
2) We need a short SOW (1–2 pages) that calls out data residency, logging retention, and roles/responsibilities.
3) Procurement questionnaire attached — fill and return.

Attachments: novaedge_proc_qs.pdf (procurement questionnaire)

Also, provide a ballpark price for 6‑week pilot and any standard commercial terms (we'll start with your standard MSA). We can then put together a purchase order.

Procurement Team
NovaEdge Health
procurement@novaedgehealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: next moves on NovaEdge (quick)

Quick internal note — copying plan here so we stay aligned: 
- I'll get the 6‑week SOW template ready today and attach SOC2 summary (redacted).
- Grace will prepare a short architecture note that highlights US-only hosting and encryption controls.
- After we return the procurement questionnaire, request a PO window and target a CFO call with Maria next week to confirm budget.
- If Maria asks on pricing, I'm prepared to present the pilot estimate and request authority to approve up to $25k pilot ARR; anything above I will escalate to sales leadership.

I'll ping once SOW + SOC2 are sent.
